Container.Name: Strata
Container.Overview:
Strata runs large mixture-of-experts models on an NVIDIA GPU plus system RAM: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next and its variants, the smaller Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Inkling-2-Mini for cards with less memory, and Tencent Hy4-Flash. It serves an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API, a chat page and a live monitor. This template runs Strata's official image.
Requirements: the Nvidia Driver plugin on driver 580 or newer and an RTX 20/30/40/50 card. For a GTX 10, P100 or V100, or a driver from 575 to 579, change the Repository tag to latest-cuda12. For the Qwen models you also need 32 GB of RAM or more (more RAM allows a larger, better model); inkling-2-mini runs on much less, and hy4-flash wants 64 GB or more. Room for the model on an SSD pool in every case.
Choosing a model: leave Model and Model family on their blank first choice and Strata picks one for this server, and the log says which and why. To choose yourself, set both. RAM below is the server's total RAM.
Reading the model names: they are compression levels, built from parts. - Q and a number (Q2_0, Q8_0): the weights are stored in fewer bits; the number is roughly the bits per weight. Fewer bits mean a smaller download and less RAM, and a little less quality. - IQ (IQ2_XS, IQ3_S): an i-quant, which keeps more quality at very low bit counts but is slower to compute. - _0: the simplest format, fast. _K: a K-quant, a middle ground between quality and size. - XXS, XS, S, M: the size within the same bit count, smallest first. XL: Unsloth's largest mix, with the most important layers kept at more bits. - UD-: Unsloth Dynamic, Unsloth's files, which choose the format layer by layer. - NVFP4: NVIDIA's 4-bit format. -NVIDIA is NVIDIA's own release; -QAD is NVIDIA's model retrained to work well at 4 bits. Gyro-S and Gyro-M: agentionai's format, small and medium. So UD-Q5_K_XL is Unsloth's file at about 5 bits per weight, in the K-quant format, in its largest mix. The number is only a guide: IQ3_S is about 3.5 bits, and the Coder's IQ1_M is stored like IQ3_S with half of the model's experts removed.
Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, the main model, for chat, code and tools (Model family qwen): - Q2_0: the fastest, good quality. 66 GB download, 48 GB RAM. - IQ2_XS: a little better, nearly as fast. 68 GB, 48 GB RAM. - IQ3_XXS: great quality, slower. 76 GB, 60 GB RAM. - IQ3_S: the best quality, matches the full model; the slowest. 84 GB, 64 GB RAM.
Other versions of Qwen3.8 (set the family shown): - swift, with the qwen sizes except Q2_0: a fine-tune by UkisAI that thinks for less time before it answers. - coder, Model IQ1_M: for code only, with half the model removed. 58 GB, 32 GB RAM. - gyro, Model Gyro-S: the least memory (about 28 GB of RAM and graphics memory together), lower quality. 59 GB. Gyro-M: about IQ3_XXS quality in 35 GB, 16-21% slower than Q2_0. 92 GB. - unsloth, Unsloth's files from 1 to 8 bits (the RAM figure keeps the whole model in memory; with less, from 48 GB for the 1- to 4-bit sizes, they still run but read part of the model from the SSD, which is much slower): UD-IQ1_M 68 GB, ~49 GB RAM; UD-Q2_0 71 GB, ~51 GB RAM; UD-IQ2_XS 76 GB, ~56 GB RAM; UD-Q2_K_XL 80 GB, ~59 GB RAM; UD-IQ3_XXS 84 GB, ~63 GB RAM; UD-Q3_K_XL 90 GB, ~69 GB RAM; UD-IQ4_XS 94 GB, 72 GB RAM; UD-Q4_K_XL 111 GB, 88 GB RAM; UD-Q5_K_XL 158 GB, 108 GB RAM; UD-Q6_K_XL 169 GB, 118 GB RAM; Q8_0 188 GB, 136 GB RAM (the reference quality). - nvfp4: NVIDIA's 4-bit format, fastest on RTX 50 cards. NVFP4 (the best of the three), NVFP4-NVIDIA or NVFP4-QAD. 102-128 GB, 80 GB RAM.
Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, a smaller model for servers with less RAM (Model family qwen36; these names are also unsloth sizes of Qwen3.8, so the family decides): - UD-Q4_K_XL: 23 GB download, 32 GB RAM. - UD-Q6_K_XL: closer to the full model. 33 GB, 44 GB RAM. - Q8_0: the closest to the full model. 38 GB, 52 GB RAM. The RAM figures are what Strata plans for, not a promise: on a 12 or 16 GB card most of the experts stay in system RAM, and if the free RAM cannot hold them the start fails with "no host memory for the experts".
Inkling-2-Mini, a small, fast model for cards with less memory (Model family inkling-2-mini). Strata's own builds: SQ-10, 10.5 GB, for a 12 GB card, or a smaller one with the rest in RAM; SQ-15, 14.3 GB, for a 16 GB card; SQ-20, 19.3 GB, nearly the full model, for a 24 GB card. Unsloth's files are offered too, from UD-IQ1_S at 7.8 GB to UD-Q8_K_XL at 22.9 GB. Pictures need 0.64 GB more. Its drafter is DSpark, which Strata keeps only where a short test at the first start finds it faster, so that start takes a few minutes longer. Context up to 256k.
Tencent Hy4-Flash, a large model in Strata's own format (Model family hy4-flash): SQ-64, 62.0 GB, for 64 GB of RAM and a card of 8 GB or more; SQ-96, 89.6 GB, for 96 GB of RAM; SQ-128, 113.7 GB, for 128 GB. Every size also reads a 67.6 GB lookup shard from the Data folder as it runs, so allow for the model and the shard together: 130 to 181 GB. Pictures need 0.93 GB more. Its drafter is DFly2. Context up to 128k.
DeepSeek is no longer offered: Strata stopped running DeepSeek models after 0.2.13. A container set to a DeepSeek model now stops at the start and says so; choose a Qwen model instead. Its files stay in the Data folder (191-274 GB) until you delete them.
First start: downloads the model into the Data folder and prepares it, which takes a while; watch the log. A stopped download resumes where it left off. Later starts go straight to serving.
API key: always on. Leave it empty and the first start makes one and keeps it in the Data folder; show it with: docker exec Strata strata launch --show-key --preset docker. Clients send it as Authorization: Bearer KEY.
Changing settings: edit them and Apply. The new values replace the saved ones on the next start; the model files and tuning stay in the Data folder.
If the log says "layer 0 never rang": the model loads and then the start stops with verify: layer 0 never rang (operation not supported on global/shared address space). That is a bug in engine 0.1.66, which came with Strata 0.2.20, and it stops every RTX 30, 40 and 50 card on a model whose files use that part of the engine. Update the container: Strata 0.2.21 and newer carry engine 0.1.67, which fixes it. To stay on 0.2.20, put STRATA_HC_Q8_TC=0 STRATA_HC_Q8_BF16TC=0 in Engine settings instead; both are needed, one alone does not help.
Template and Unraid problems: the Support link. Strata itself: the Project link.

Container.Requires: **Nvidia Driver plugin** on driver 580 or newer (575+ with the cuda12 tag). Do not set a memory limit on the container: Strata plans from the server's whole RAM. Do not pin CPUs: the engine sets its own thread affinity.

Config.Name: WebUI / API port
Config.Description: Chat page, monitor and the API (/v1 for OpenAI clients, the root URL for Anthropic clients).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The model, the prepared pack, presets, tuning and the API key: tens of GB, up to 188 GB for the largest, or 181 GB for hy4-flash SQ-128 with its lookup shard; the log names the size. Use a direct pool path on an NVMe drive (/mnt/cache/... or /mnt/POOLNAME/...), not /mnt/user: the engine reads the model files while it runs.

Config.Name: GPU
Config.Description: The cards the container sees: a UUID (GPU-xxxxxxxx-...) from the Nvidia Driver plugin page or nvidia-smi -L, several separated by commas, or all. With exactly two RTX 30 or two RTX 50 class cards, a supported Qwen3.8 file and a context up to 128k, Strata uses its all-cards split engine by itself.

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: The blank first choice: Strata picks for this server, and the log says which and why. Otherwise set Model family too: a size the family does not offer stops the start with a message listing the sizes it does. Sizes by family: qwen Q2_0, IQ2_XS, IQ3_XXS, IQ3_S; swift the same without Q2_0; coder IQ1_M; gyro Gyro-S, Gyro-M; unsloth the UD- sizes and Q8_0; nvfp4 the NVFP4 sizes; qwen36 UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL, Q8_0; inkling-2-mini SQ-10, SQ-15, SQ-20 and the UD- sizes from UD-IQ1_S to UD-Q8_K_XL; hy4-flash SQ-64, SQ-96, SQ-128. A UD- name belongs to several families, so the family decides which model you get. The Overview explains the names and lists every size with its download and RAM.

Config.Name: Model family
Config.Description: Which model, or which version of it. The blank first choice: Strata's pick. qwen: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, the main model. swift: Qwen3.8 tuned to think for less time (IQ2_XS, IQ3_XXS, IQ3_S). coder: Qwen3.8 for code only, in less RAM. gyro: Qwen3.8 in the least memory, slower. unsloth: Unsloth's Qwen3.8 files, 1 to 8 bits; the larger ones for servers with a lot of RAM. nvfp4: Qwen3.8 in NVIDIA's 4-bit format, fastest on RTX 50. qwen36: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, a smaller model for 32-52 GB of RAM. inkling-2-mini: Inkling-2-Mini from Thinking Machines, small and fast, for cards from about 8 GB. hy4-flash: Tencent Hy4-Flash, large, for 64 GB of RAM or more.

Config.Name: Context length
Config.Description: How much text it remembers at once. Longer costs memory. Strata offers 8k to 512k for the Qwen models, up to 256k for inkling-2-mini and up to 128k for hy4-flash; a size the model does not offer stops the start with a message.

Config.Name: Vision
Config.Description: on: the model reads pictures (about 0.9 GB more to download; 0.64 GB for inkling-2-mini, 0.93 GB for hy4-flash). gpu or cpu choose where the picture reader runs.

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: 16 characters or more (openssl rand -hex 24 makes one). Empty: the first start makes one and keeps it in the Data folder.

Config.Name: Tuning
Config.Description: Measures the best engine settings for this server, once, on the next start, and keeps them. thorough takes longer than quick; how long depends on the hardware.

Config.Name: Tune again
Config.Description: 1 tunes again on the next start even if this preset is already tuned, for example after an update. Set it back to 0 afterwards.

Config.Name: Allow tuning to change answers
Config.Description: 1 lets the tuner also try settings that can change answers very slightly. 0 keeps only settings that leave answers the same.

Config.Name: Parallel requests
Config.Description: Requests answered at the same time, 1 to 8. Empty: fitted to the card. With 2 or more, Strata uses the MTP drafter, because its default DFlash2 drafter answers one request at a time.

Config.Name: Drafting
Config.Description: The drafter guesses words ahead so answers come faster. auto (recommended): DFlash2 where the engine has it, else MTP, and MTP when Parallel requests is 2 or more. dflash2 downloads its drafter once (0.3 to 1.2 GB). off: no drafter. mtp and dflash2 are the Qwen drafters: inkling-2-mini has DSpark and hy4-flash has DFly2, so leave this on auto for those two and Strata uses theirs.

Config.Name: Draft vocabulary
Config.Description: Which words the drafter may guess. cjk (the default) includes Chinese, Japanese and Korean. en, cyrillic, fr, latin and arabic each keep English and code, and use less graphics memory: en the least.

Config.Name: KV cache type
Config.Description: Conversation memory format: int8 (default), q4_0 (half the memory), k8v4, fp16.

Config.Name: Existing model files
Config.Description: GGUF files you already have, as a path inside the container. Add a Path mapping for their folder (read-only is fine), e.g. /models, and enter that here; set Model too. Nothing is downloaded for the model itself.

Config.Name: Download despite old model files
Config.Description: When model files from the older image are still in /data/models, the start stops instead of downloading the model again (tens of GB) and the log says where they are. Use them with Existing model files, or set 1 to download anyway.

Config.Name: GPU roles
Config.Description: Several cards: a role for each, e.g. 1=main,0=helper (main, helper or off; cards you do not name are off). Empty: the engine's choice. See docs/MULTI_GPU.md in the Strata repository.

Config.Name: Engine settings
Config.Description: Advanced engine settings, space separated KEY=VALUE, like strata launch --set. For example STRATA_ROUTE_TAIL_SKIP=7 skips rarely used parts of the model: a little faster, but answers differ slightly (off by default since 0.2.17). docs/SETTINGS.md in the Strata repository lists every setting.
